create_logger_for_rl_training: create a Logger instance with a log directory to track training and eval metrics via CSV and W&B
log_scalar_metric: log a scalar metric value with a train or eval prefix key and step number to the Logger
log_batch_metrics: log a dictionary of metrics at once using log_metrics with a step and train or eval type
use_log_and_dump_context: use the log_and_dump_ctx context manager to log multiple metrics and auto-dump them to CSV on exit
dump_metrics_to_csv_and_console: call dump on the Logger to flush all pending train and eval metrics to CSV files and the console
